arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case's counsel argued a timely notice of appeal never lacks jurisdiction solely due to a missing signature.
the opposing side's counsel asserted the Sixth Circuit applied its jurisdictional rule to single appellants.
Chief Justice Rehnquist closed the argument by stating the case was submitted.
